scenarios.title: Ordering Coffee at a Café
scenarios.ai_role: Barista at a busy café in Madrid
scenarios.user_task: Order a hot coffee with milk, ask for the price, and pay.

scenarios.title: Asking for Train Station Directions
scenarios.ai_role: Information desk clerk at a train station
scenarios.user_task: Find out which platform goes to the airport and ask what time the next train leaves.
scenarios.opening_line: Buenas tardes, ¿en qué le puedo ayudar?

scenarios.title: Booking a Doctor's Appointment
scenarios.user_task: Explain that you feel unwell, describe two symptoms, and book an appointment for tomorrow morning.
scenarios.opening_line: Buenos días, Centro Médico San Martín. ¿En qué puedo ayudarle?

scenarios.title: A Short Job Interview
scenarios.ai_role: Hiring manager at a technology company
scenarios.user_task: Introduce yourself, describe your previous experience, and ask two questions about the team and working hours.
scenarios.opening_line: Gracias por venir. Cuénteme un poco sobre usted y su experiencia.

scenarios.title: Debating Environmental Policy
scenarios.ai_role: Moderator of a city council public debate
scenarios.user_task: Present your stance on a proposed plastic ban, respond to a counter-argument, and propose an alternative solution.
scenarios.opening_line: Adelante, tiene la palabra. ¿Está a favor o en contra de la prohibición de plásticos de un solo uso?
